product_one_liner.value: Upstage builds enterprise AI products—including its Solar large language models and document-processing tools—to automate document-heavy business workflows for organizations.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its LLM and document-processing engines as enterprise workflow tools.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans and prices are listed for Studio and API products.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear on Upstage customer-story pages.

employee_band.notes: Upstage says it has 100+ team members; LinkedIn lists the company size as 51–200. Together, these support the 101–200 band.

hq_location.notes: The company’s official about page provides its Seoul, South Korea address. LinkedIn lists San Jose as a headquarters location, but the official company page gives the Seoul head-office address.

founded_year.notes: Upstage’s about page says it was founded in 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes multiple engineering-oriented posts, including a RAG implementation and a post on deploying Solar with BentoML.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation includes multiple product and developer guides, capability documentation, deployment options, and API references.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open roles page lists AI Research Engineer roles, including LLM Evaluation & Analysis.

model_provider.value: Upstage’s own Solar models, including Solar Pro 4 and Solar Mini 4.
model_provider.notes: The company publicly describes Solar as its own model family; no third-party provider is identified as the provider of these models.

compliance_certs.notes: The cited page explicitly says Upstage is certified for SOC 2, HIPAA, and ISO 27001/27701. ISO 27701 is omitted because it is outside the requested certification list.

last_funding.notes: A November 9, 2026 report describes a planned NVIDIA investment in Upstage’s Series C extension, but says the investment amount is undisclosed and does not establish that it closed. The exact amount required for this field therefore cannot be supplied; 0 is a placeholder, not a claim of a zero-dollar round.

raised_18mo.notes: On November 9, 2026, Dealroom reported a planned NVIDIA investment in an extension of Upstage’s Series C, within the 18-month window. The investment amount and closing status were not disclosed.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current openings include an SDR (Sales Development Representative) position.

launched_6mo.notes: Upstage announced the Studio product launch on October 6, 2026, within the six months before the run date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available company page identifies the CEO but does not provide a complete, dated leadership roster, and I found no verifiable announcement of a C-level or VP-level join or departure in the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable open-role listings and public developer documentation reviewed did not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
